views.name: security.layer4_search_blocked_providers
views.definition:
SELECT layer4_active_blocks.entity_id AS provider_id
   FROM security.layer4_active_blocks
  WHERE layer4_active_blocks.block_scope = 'search'::text AND layer4_active_blocks.entity_type = 'provider'::text
UNION
 SELECT h.provider_id
   FROM security.provider_hidden_v1 h;

views.name: security.provider_hidden_v1

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_jobs_governed_idempotency_uq ON pipeline.admin_jobs USING btree (((args ->> 'idempotency_key'::text))) WHERE (kind = 'governed_action'::text)
CREATE INDEX admin_jobs_kind_scope_idx ON pipeline.admin_jobs USING btree (kind, scope, state)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_jobs_pkey ON pipeline.admin_jobs USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX admin_jobs_lane_state_idx ON pipeline.admin_jobs USING btree (lane, state, created_at)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_jobs_run_now_idempotency_uq ON pipeline.admin_jobs USING btree (((args ->> 'idempotency_key'::text))) WHERE ((kind = 'job_run_now'::text) AND (args ? 'idempotency_key'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_description_reads_pkey ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX provider_description_reads_open_uq ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (provider_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'reading'::text, 'proposed'::text]))
CREATE INDEX provider_description_reads_state_idx ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (state, next_try_at)
CREATE INDEX provider_description_reads_provider_idx ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (provider_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX provider_description_reads_review_idx ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (review_item_id)
CREATE INDEX provider_description_reads_evidence_idx ON pipeline.provider_description_reads USING btree (evidence_id)
